requirements.title: Manuscript Copyediting and Proofreading
requirements.definition: Polish the manuscript's grammar, punctuation, clarity, flow, and repetition while preserving the author's intended meaning and voice.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers editorial correctness and polish. Incorporating the client's latest authorized wording and maintaining the correct working file are separated as content-integrity behavior.

requirements.title: Final Manuscript Content Integrity
requirements.definition: Ensure the delivered manuscript uses the client-designated working file and retains all approved additions, deletions, dedication text, passage rewrites, and other authorized content changes.
requirements.boundary_note: Individual passage edits are attributes of one authoritative-content mechanism because the recurring requirement is that the final file incorporate the complete approved revision set. General grammar and stylistic quality remain separate.

requirements.title: Book Title Text Integrity
requirements.definition: Render the approved book title without unintended control characters, line-marker text, or other textual corruption.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers correctness of the title text itself. The relative placement of the title and author name is an independently changeable layout Requirement.

requirements.title: Chapter Image Suitability
requirements.definition: Review and use chapter illustrations that fit the book's subject, tone, and colour palette, including client-supplied AI-generated images.
requirements.boundary_note: Image suitability is independently reviewable from where images are placed and whether they render without distortion.

requirements.title: Chapter Image Placement
requirements.definition: Place the designated illustration at the beginning of every chapter using the client-selected full-page presentation.
requirements.boundary_note: The number, chapter mapping, and full-page placement are attributes of one illustration-placement mechanism. Visual rendering defects are separately testable.

requirements.title: Chapter Image Rendering Quality
requirements.definition: Render inserted chapter images without elongation, cropping, corner artifacts, or unacceptable pixelation.
requirements.boundary_note: Rendering quality can fail while image selection and placement remain correct, so it is an independent acceptance behavior.

requirements.title: Paperback Format and Trim Size
requirements.definition: Prepare the book for paperback publication using the selected 6-by-9-inch trim size.
requirements.boundary_note: Paperback format and trim size form one physical-format specification that constrains pagination and cover dimensions without subsuming those independent deliverables.

requirements.title: Title and Author Page Layout
requirements.definition: Use the client-approved title-page composition and preserve the accepted relative presentation of the author's name and book title.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers title-page composition and author-name placement, not the correctness of the title text or the external paperback cover.

requirements.title: Chapter Heading and Table-of-Contents Typography
requirements.definition: Format chapter titles, subtitles, and table-of-contents entries consistently, including correction of the Chapter 14 and Chapter 18 heading treatments.
requirements.boundary_note: Groups related heading-hierarchy and typography rules. Page-number generation and TOC page references are a separate pagination mechanism.

requirements.title: Special Section Typography
requirements.definition: Apply the requested typographic treatment to recurring special sections, including italic formatting for Mama's Hot Take text.
requirements.boundary_note: The recurring special-section style is independently changeable from chapter-heading hierarchy and ordinary body-text spacing.

requirements.title: Pagination and Table-of-Contents Accuracy
requirements.definition: Add page numbers after the trim size is fixed and ensure the table of contents reflects the final pagination.
requirements.boundary_note: Page numbering and TOC page references are tightly coupled by final pagination and therefore remain attributes of one mechanism.

requirements.title: Body Text Density and Paragraph Spacing
requirements.definition: Control body-page spacing and text density, with the current concise layout retained while additional paragraph spacing remains a possible later revision.
requirements.boundary_note: Spacing was explicitly discussed and deferred independently of other formatting work, establishing a separate lifecycle.

requirements.title: Copyright Page Alignment
requirements.definition: Use the accepted standard centre-aligned treatment for the copyright page while preserving justified body-page text.
requirements.boundary_note: Alignment can be modified independently from the copyright page's attribution, contact details, and ISBN content.

requirements.title: Copyright Page Attribution and Contact Details
requirements.definition: Maintain the approved copyright-page attribution and contact information, omitting the Cedar Nest Family Circle publication line, retaining the working email address, and leaving website addition for later.
requirements.boundary_note: Publisher attribution, email, and future website reference are closely related copyright-page metadata fields. ISBN placement has a distinct source and acceptance condition.

requirements.title: ISBN Placement on Copyright Page
requirements.definition: Include the book's ISBN on the copyright page.
requirements.boundary_note: ISBN placement is an independently requested metadata behavior and should not be merged with the earlier publisher-line and contact-details decision.

requirements.title: Paperback Cover Design
requirements.definition: Produce a suitable paperback cover containing the necessary title and publication details and sized for the final book specification.
requirements.boundary_note: The external paperback cover is independent from the interior title page and from chapter-image placement.

requirements.title: Back Matter and Author Biography
requirements.definition: Prepare the required back matter and brief author-description content for the paperback.
requirements.boundary_note: This is a distinct written publication asset, separate from cover design and the operational KDP publication workflow.

requirements.title: Guided KDP Publishing Assistance
requirements.definition: Provide the KDP listing material, including keywords, and guide the client through entering the information and uploading the paperback from the client's own laptop, with help if the client becomes blocked.
requirements.boundary_note: Keywords, prepared listing material, guided entry, and upload support form one client-operated KDP workflow. Cover and back-matter creation remain independent deliverables.

requirements.title: Paperback Publishing Readiness Guidance
requirements.definition: Advise the client on the steps and required front-matter, back-matter, sizing, copyright, cover, and other prerequisites needed to publish the manuscript successfully as a paperback.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the independently requested advisory deliverable. Concrete artifacts and operational work identified through that guidance are represented by narrower Requirements.
